operationalLimits.appliesTo: Emergency engine-generator sets (00GEN-1 through 05GEN-1, and HGEN)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Nitrogen oxide (NOx) emissions shall be controlled by a turbocharged engine and aftercooler. Documentation demonstrating the engine control device is enabled on each engine-generator set must be maintained.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Emergency engine-generator sets (00GEN-1 through 05GEN-1, and HGEN)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Nitrogen oxide (NOx) emissions shall be controlled by the use of good operating practices and performing appropriate maintenance in accordance with the manufacturer recommendations. Settings may only be changed if permitted by the manufacturer and do not increase air emissions.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Each emergency engine-generator set (00GEN-1 through 05GEN-1, and HGEN)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Must be equipped with a non-resettable hour metering device to monitor operating hours. Hour meter readings must be observed daily when operated and logged. Each hour meter shall be provided with adequate access for inspection.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Each emergency engine-generator set (00GEN-1 through 05GEN-1, and HGEN)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Operate and maintain according to manufacturer's written instructions or permittee-developed procedures approved by the engine manufacturer. Settings may only be changed if permitted by the manufacturer and do not increase air emissions.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Emergency engine-generator sets (00GEN-1 through 05GEN-1, and HGEN)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Operation restricted to sudden and unforeseeable events causing primary power disruption (electrical grid failure, on-site disaster, public service emergencies) or ISO-declared emergencies (abnormal system condition, capacity deficiency/excess, fuel shortage, abnormal natural/man-made threats, abnormal external ISO events). Also permitted for periodic maintenance, testing, and operational training. Total emissions for any 12-month period shall not exceed annual limits in Conditions 9 and 10.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Each emergency engine-generator set (00GEN-1 through 05GEN-1, and HGEN)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Not more than 500 hours per year, including up to 100 hours/year for maintenance checks and readiness testing, calculated monthly as the sum of each consecutive 12-month period.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Emergency engine-generator sets (00GEN-1 through 05GEN-1, and HGEN)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Diesel fuel meeting ASTM D975 specification for S15 diesel fuel oil with a maximum sulfur content per shipment of 0.0015%.
Obtain fuel supplier certification for each diesel fuel shipment, including supplier name, receipt date, and statement of compliance with ASTM D975 for S15 diesel fuel oil.

emissionLimits.limitValue: 10 percent opacity, except during one six-minute period in any one hour not exceeding 20 percent opacity
emissionLimits.conditions: As determined by EPA Method 9 (reference 40 CFR 60, Appendix A). Applies at all times except during startup, shutdown, and malfunction.
